method: one independent text-only native generation per asset
bbox_format: [left, top, right, bottom] in native output pixels, threshold alpha >=128; right and bottom exclusive
notes: All outputs inspected visually and with read-only Pillow metadata/alpha analysis.
All 11 native files are 1254×1254 RGBA PNGs with real alpha transparency and complete silhouettes.
Use the supplied visible alpha bounds when sizing different silhouettes; native framing is more variable than the requested central 75%.
Minor low-alpha edge haze may exist outside the recorded visible bounds. No bitmap cleanup, resizing, cropping or other programmatic edit was applied.
